'''Outland forlag''' is a publishing company headquartered in Norway. They publish comics and manga in Norwegian, including [[Pokémon manga]]. 

==Pokémon titles licensed by Outland forlag==
* [[Pokémon Adventures]] ([[List of Pokémon Adventures volumes|regular tankōbon volumes]]; each arc with its own numbering)
** {{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}} (2021-2022, three volumes)
** {{MangaArc|Yellow}} (2022, four volumes)
** {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}} (2023-2025, eight volumes)
** {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}} (2025-present, ongoing)
